title: Chapter 833
paragraphs: Chapter 833
Episode 209. The Seventh Tomb of Temar - Keitam's Painting (6)
"Barisada is a key...? I've never heard such a thing."
Murakan tilted his head and spoke.
It was also the first time Jin had heard this story.

"It's something we only recently learned from the housekeeper. We don't know exactly where the key leads to, but we only heard that it should never fall into the hands of the fake Murakan or the witch. It's said that it would bring about a great danger to the world....."
Already, Jin and Murakan have had the experience of a sword being used as a key through the Bale of Shakan.
'So is Barisada also a key to open another tomb of Temar? But for some reason, I feel it could be something else….. If it was related to the tomb from the beginning, Picon must have known it.'
Picon Minche is the one who informed Jin about the first tomb of Temar. He was the 'messenger' who heard directly from Solderet about the tomb.
Therefore, there's no reason for Solderet to omit information about Barisada while appointing Picon as the messenger for the first tomb. Moreover, Picon was also the creator of Barisada.

'Two assumptions come to mind. First, Picon knew about the secret of Barisada but forgot due to the manipulation of history. Second, Solderet added a special mechanism or ability to Barisada without even Picon knowing.'
Either way, it was clear that the secret of Barisada had not caused any problems in the world to date.

The real Barisada is currently held by Chiron Runcandel. Furthermore, in the thousand years of Runcandel's history after Temar, there was not a single instance where Barisada was used by someone other than a member of the family.
Of course, the fact that Barisada is a key could also be a setting created as part of the 'corruption'. Until faced with the truth of the painting, nothing could be certain.
'Perhaps my father went on the expedition to the Black Sea because he knew the secret of Barisada.....'
Suddenly, he missed Chiron and Luna, and the expedition party.
'My father, who I saw in my afterworld, still looked strong. As my father said then, if I keep doing my job, there will be a day when we meet again.'
He felt a strange feeling. He had never thought that he would miss his father. Now, he missed him and Luna more than ever.
"An unknown great danger..... Either way, it's a big mess. Right, we must definitely protect it since Lueth wouldn't have spoken nonsense."
"Over there? Is there a problem somewhere else too?"
"Ah, there was a bit of a commotion in Lafrarosa too. It's not as serious as here, so don't worry."
Murakan mentioned Lafrarosa casually and nodded. Frey blinked as if something was strange, but did not ask any further.
"Do you have any idea when the fake Murakan will attack?"

"We don't know. But as he continues to attack other areas and provoke us, it's unlikely he'd rashly engage in a frontal battle. That's why we were even more surprised today. There has never been an instance where the Fortress of Storm was directly attacked before."
"So that's why Dranakhs asked me if the enemy had finally extended his clutches to the Fortress of Storm."

"Right, Murakan! He doesn't have the confidence to face us directly. That's why he's tormenting weak people and trying to lure at least one of us elsewhere. So far, I just thought it was because he was injured fighting with Ga-ju, but now I see it was because he was a fake!"
With Frey's judgment falling into place, Dranakhs now completely believed in Jin and Murakan's words.
"Of course! If it were the real me, would you three have been afraid? We would have already made a frontal breakthrough."
"Haha, Murakan! That's a bit hurtful! This guy is underestimating us! Right, Vyollo?"
"I agree. We are the Ten Knights, Murakan. Do you know what the Ten Knights are?"

"Honestly, it's a fact that I'm incredibly strong, right? Of course, it wouldn't be easy for me to defeat all three of you and the elite knights at once. But if I knew that Barisada was in the Fortress of Storm, it would be easy to charge, beat everyone, take the sword and escape. Can't you admit that?"
"It's more frustrating because we have to admit it. Right, Vyollo?"
"It's frustrating that you keep agreeing with him, Dranakhs."
"See, Frey. Vyollo and I get along so well. All the fighting and stuff is just a joke."
"Well, yes. Murakan is strong!"
Murakan, Dranakhs, and Vyollo burst into laughter, while Jin and Frey sighed inwardly. Jin was embarrassed by Murakan, and Frey was embarrassed by both of them.
"Have you all eaten?"
"Yes, we grabbed something simple on the way here."

"Even so, you've exerted yourselves, so let me prepare some food. There won't be much to do while waiting anyway. I'll also prepare some reports related to the fake Murakan, so take your time to review them while eating."
"Understood, Commander Frey."

"Now that we've accepted you and Murakan, I feel very reassured. Murakan, I wish we could hold a welcoming ceremony for you and Vamel upon your return. But as you can see, it's not the right situation. I hope you're not upset."
"Do you think I'd be that petty?"
"Instead, let's have a grand welcome when everyone is back. When the governor and other comrades gather back at the Storm Castle."

Murakan couldn't hide his bitter feelings, showing an awkward smile. The scene that Frey was talking about was one that could not be seen again, neither in this world within the painting nor in reality.
Frey seemed to read something from Murakan's expression but added no words. Jin quietly patted Murakan's back while she and the knights were looking elsewhere.

The Storm Castle's dining room was no different from now. The repaired parts due to its old age were clean as new, and even the weather was sunny, unlike the usual Storm Castle. The sunlight breaking through the window gaps was beautiful.

As they reviewed the report, dishes came out one by one. The news that the Murakan with Jin is the real Murakan had spread throughout the Storm Castle, and the servants greeted Murakan with tears of joy.
"We thought that you had truly become a demon, Murakan... I can't tell you how much we resented you. My son died in Lolon not long ago, caught in that bastard's breath. Please avenge him."
"I can't express how happy I am that you've returned, Lord Murakan. We've prepared the foods you usually enjoy."
Various kinds of pies came out continuously along with the meat.
"Your eating habits haven't changed in a thousand years."

"But back then, there was no one who could make a strawberry pie as perfectly as a strawberry pie. Ah, I miss the strawberry pie. It must be lonely and desolate without me. I wonder how much it misses me..."
"Really... How dreadful. Your rant about the strawberry pie, no, Gilly has gotten worse since you finished representing Misha."
"Huh, isn't that obvious? Three years is a short time for a dragon, but not for Gilly. What would a youngster like you know about how it feels to give affection to a being with a limited lifespan?"
"I meant to refrain from such cringe-inducing talk in public."
"Are you and I strangers?"
"Enough. Eat your pie. Have some water."

"Well, it's not as good as the strawberry pie, but it has its nostalgic taste. I like pies, and there were even guys who dared to open a pie shop in my name. Of course, they're commoners, so I didn't particularly penalize them. I did go there secretly, eat, and then transform into a Black Dragon to surprise them."

Jin focused on the report as soon as he was full. Just by looking at the content a little, he could tell how much trouble the Storm Castle had been going through to keep track of the fake Murakan's movements.
"How many cities and towns have been destroyed in just the past month? How many knights have died while tracking him?"
Soon, Jin found out that there was a certain pattern in the fake Murakan's behavior.

'The reports from when the fake attacked the Huphester region all came from the outside. On the other hand, the ones from Mitel were all directly written by the knights of Storm Castle... Recently, he's only committing massacres in the Mitel Kingdom.'
The fake had been attacking Mitel every two to three days.
"Have you looked into it?"

"Yes, recently the fake is targeting only Mitel, Knight Frey. And the places he attacked in the last ten days, Schulby, Tulan, Kitya, Lolon are all not far from Storm Castle in terms of the fake's standards. It's as if he's sweeping the outskirts of Mitel and closing in on the Storm Castle..."
"We were also noticing that. If this is his movement, his next hunting ground will probably be Lugado, and then Mito."
Lugado was a nearby city, and Mito was the village under the mountain that Jin and Murakan had visited first.
"So, we've issued evacuation orders in Lugado and Mito, and other nearby areas, and sent knights to control them."
"When Lugado, Mito, and other adjacent areas are all destroyed, the only places left for the fake to attack are far from the Storm Castle."
"What do you think, Vamel? After he's finished with those areas, do you think the fake will target the distant areas again, or will he target the Storm Castle?"
Jin was lost in thought for a moment.

'The Ten Knights are surely extremely strong... but Murakan's power written in the report is likely beyond that. With his breath capable of turning a city into ashes, it wouldn't be a stretch to go head-to-head with the Storm Castle where three of the Ten Knights reside.'
He recalled the words of a villager.

"...In my opinion, the fake believes he can certainly seize the Storm Castle, except in the case where Temar returns due to Numerus's healing. So if Temar doesn't personally come to save them while he's attacking nearby, I think he'll march on the Storm Castle."
"Huh, the chances of the governor returning right now are very slim. Then it seems the fake will come soon..."
And that evening.

The guardian knights of the family, who should have issued evacuation orders to the nearby city and returned, did not return to Storm Castle. From the night, a storm started raging like crazy. As if the sunny weather that lasted until the afternoon was all a lie.
And then, a black dragon was tearing the dark clouds menacingly, flying towards the Storm Castle. It was the fake Murakan.
